summary: Dingdong (Cayman) Limited filed a Form 6-K on October 2, 2026, disclosing an ordinary board change rather than a special situation. Independent director Ed Chan Yiu Cheong resigned effective September 30, 2026, citing personal reasons and no dispute with the company; the board appointed Le Yu as independent director effective October 1, 2026, succeeding his board and committee roles. The board confirmed Yu meets NYSE independence standards and Exchange Act Rule 10A-3 audit committee requirements. No deal terms, advisors, shareholder stakes, or transaction mechanics are involved; no risk-arb angle applies.
